title: Validity Periods and Extension Allowances, Larkspur Closing Cost Credit Programs
content:
Every Larkspur Closing Cost Credit is valid for a set number of calendar days after the reservation date, and some programs allow a limited number of validity extensions. The terms differ by program:

| Credit program | Validity (calendar days after the reservation date) | Extensions allowed | Calendar days added by one extension | File statuses in which an extension may be granted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | 90 | 1 | 30 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | 90 | 1 | 30 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | 120 | 1 | 30 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | 120 | 0 | 0 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | 180 | 2 | 60 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | 120 | 1 | 30 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | 120 | 1 | 30 | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close |

### Notes

- The calendar days added by one extension are 0 where the program allows no extension; the Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee is the only such program.
- The Larkspur Builder Partner Credit is the only program allowing two extensions, and its figures (180 days of validity, 60 days per extension) are the largest in the schedule.
- The file statuses for an extension are the same for every program; a file that is only disclosed is not among them, nor is a file in any status after clear to close.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A Larkspur First Home Credit with its one extension granted has been given 120 days of validity and 30 days of extension, 150 calendar days in all after its reservation date; a second extension is not among its allowances.
